name: Maple Colors H
source:
Compared to the original, Maple Colors H is more for fun (i.e. “H”) than character development and gameplay. You play with the familiar characters from the original in a series in some random plots.

[From White Masq]
translation:
与原作相比，《Maple Colors H》更侧重于“H”方面的乐趣，而非角色发展和玩法。你将与原作中熟悉的角色们一起，在一系列随机剧情中展开游戏。

[引自White Masq]
